correctness.rationale: Direct projection of normalized signed harmonic monomials gives a single frequency shift for T_(z^r). Comparing T_z T_(z^m) with T_(z^m) T_z leaves precisely the m input modes -m through -1, with coefficients beta*mu_m*(m+1-2q)/[(q+beta)(m-q+1+beta)*sqrt(mu_q*mu_(m-q+1))]. Distinct orthogonal inputs/outputs yield the full singular-value list, including a zero for odd m. Gamma-ratio bounds supply the bulk density beta*(1-2t)[t(1-t)]^(beta/2-1), the two summable endpoint sequences, and the harmonic logarithm exactly when p=2/(1-alpha). Fixed beta and p are essential. Independent direct coefficient calculations for beta=.5,1,3 and m<=11 corroborated this reduction; the proof's summation estimates, not the finite computations, establish all-degree limits.
